caption:
Google changed your listing rules this fall.

Starting late September 2026, Google's Business Profile help page gives you 4 days to accept or reject a user-suggested edit before it may publish automatically.

That edit could be your hours. Your phone number. Your address.

Do this today:
1. Turn on profile notifications (email and in-app)
2. Check your suggested edits tab now
3. Match your website's hours, phone, and address to your profile exactly

Google leans on your own website to decide whether a bad edit looks legitimate. If they don't match, you're exposed.

A wrong number on your listing doesn't bounce. It just goes unanswered by someone who needed you today.
